pages: Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, reads one folded printed notice at a council desk. Middle distance: a rolled chart, a mug, a brass lamp. Background: an office window, grey sea beyond. Flat overcast daylight.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, grips one thick green kelp stipe with both hands underwater. Middle distance: a stony bottom, floating blades, a pea-sized gas bladder. Background: dim green water, a moving canopy far above.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, crouches on bare rock with one hand laid flat on a single dinner-plate holdfast. Middle distance: stipes rising through the water, a slate, grey gravel. Background: pale green water, surface light far above.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, hangs beside one one-metre quadrat frame at twelve metres, counting holdfasts inside it. Middle distance: the shot line, old stipes, red urchins. Background: deep blue-green water, thin light from above.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, stands in a timber shed on a rise above the road with one hand on a nine-metre ash stripper shaft. Middle distance: a cardboard invoice box, sawdust, a workbench. Background: the open shed door, a grass rise, overcast morning.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, leans over the stern rail of a tender, one yellow camera housing held down over the water. Middle distance: the stern roller, a paper fix roll, a coil of rope. Background: a grey bay, low sun on the water.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, reads one screen showing a mottled dark patch, a pencil in her other hand. Middle distance: her field sheet, a thermos, a rolled chart. Background: the wheelhouse window, evening light on the water.

Rennie Toon, a man of sixty-one, a grey beard, a green waterproof jacket, draws one smooth line round a polygon on a printed chart. Middle distance: a laptop showing a track, a steel ruler, a coffee cup going cold. Background: an office window with the bay below it, flat grey daylight.

Taine Peirse, a man of twenty-six, dark hair, a grey jumper under a navy work shirt, opens one blue application folder at his desk, a finger on the top sheet. Middle distance: a pencil, a stapler, a mug. Background: a window with the harbour below, a grey notice board, overcast daylight.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, kneels on the bottom at twelve metres, writing on one white counting slate with a pencil. Middle distance: a quadrat frame, the shot line, a torch beam. Background: dim blue-green water, surface far above.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, pulls one long stipe aside on the bottom at twelve metres, old plants crowding about her. Middle distance: a quadrat frame, red urchins, a slate. Background: dark green water, thin light from the surface.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, reaches out from the shot line and puts one hand on clean bare rock. Middle distance: gravel packed with red urchins, a mat of floating plants, a slate. Background: brown-green water, dim light from the mat above.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, watches one red marker buoy astern of the tender, a wake running between. Middle distance: the stern rail, a field sheet, a wind sock. Background: grey water, low sun, the far shore.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, clips one paper chart to the rail of the tender in a seaway. Middle distance: spray over the rail, a coiled line, a lifejacket. Background: white water, a grey squall sky.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, lifts the neck of one hessian sack of beached kelp on the sand. Middle distance: a wrack line of weed, a fence post, a field book. Background: surf and a grey morning sea.

Neville Pyke, a man of fifty-nine, a weathered face, an orange oilskin, unrolls one old sea chart across a meeting table and lays a finger on it. Middle distance: a permit folder, a mug, a chair pushed back. Background: an office window with the harbour in it, flat overcast light.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, clicks one hand tally counter on the office table beside a survey sheet. Middle distance: a field book, a laptop, a pencil. Background: a window with grey water beyond, flat daylight.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, stands on a mussel-farm jetty beside one open budget ledger on a crate. Middle distance: stacked mussel trays, a set of scales, a rope bollard. Background: the works shed and the harbour hills, low sun.

Taine Peirse, a man of twenty-six, dark hair, a grey jumper under a navy work shirt, taps one printed application form on the desk with a pen, and frowns. Middle distance: the open blue folder, a monitor, a mug. Background: an office window with the harbour below, flat grey daylight.

Taine Peirse, a man of twenty-six, dark hair, a grey jumper under a navy work shirt, reads one screen showing a single yellowed invoice, and reads it again. Middle distance: the open folder, his hand flat on the desk, a mug. Background: an office window, low afternoon sun on the wall.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, signs one annexe sheet with a pen at a council desk. Middle distance: the survey sheet, a dive log, a coffee cup. Background: a window on the street, evening light.

Hine Raukura, a woman of thirty-eight, black hair in a short plait, a charcoal wetsuit under an open rust-orange oilskin jacket, floats under one returning mat of drifting kelp, her hand out in the blades. Middle distance: gravel bottom, red urchins, the shot line. Background: green light coming down through the weed, a moving swell.
